heroText: Denpasar works best as a base in Indonesia when you anchor days around Bajra Sandhi Monument, Puputan Square and Bali Museum. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Bali Denpasar handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.text: The royal palace was looted and razed during the Dutch intervention in 1906.
Tuban Airfield, now part of Denpasar International Airport, opened in 1931.

history.label: Today
history.text: In the 18th and 19th centuries, Denpasar functioned as the capital of the Hindu Majapahit Kingdom of Badung, thus the city's former name being Badung.

history.label: Regional role
history.text: It was later resolved that meeting the needs and demands of the burgeoning urban community would be best addressed by giving Denpasar administrative independence from Badung Regency.
